text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: While walking around town with Still in Love, I found a book café she might like. Hoping it would be a nice change of pace, we went inside...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...So many novels.
I can't help but get distracted..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Oh my... this book is—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Just as I thought.
This cover... is just as I remember it."
choice_data_list: Is that a novel you've read before?
Is that a novel you've read before?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Yes, I have before.
...It was a historical novel set in the Sengoku period.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I was so captivated by the dramatic lives of samurai
living through turbulent eras...
that I would shut myself in my room, engrossed in reading.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
That exhilaration I felt before...
Reminiscing about it might be lovely, too.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, I picked out a novel myself
and decided to read alongside her.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: ...It was a wonderful story.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To see her, usually so quiet and reserved,
looking so visibly moved...
choice_data_list: May I ask what kind of story it is?

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Yes... No matter how many words I use, I could never fully describe this book, but—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Reading it again, what touched my heart the most...
was the samurai protagonist's deep, yearning love
for his betrothed.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
In this era, political marriages were the norm...
Yet, as fortune would have it, the two
truly and genuinely loved each other.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"We will surely build a happy home together as husband and wife."
Such was the vow they shared...
However, the fiancé succumbed to illness and passed away.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
However, the protagonist continued to hold feelings for his betrothed...
and even after casting aside his status as a samurai...
he remained... single... forever—

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...I-I'm sorry...!
My heart, it's just racing again—..."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
Because they are my most beloved...
No matter how far apart we are, I will think of them forever.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
It is a very... very
heartbreaking, yet beautiful tale.
choice_data_list: That novel must really mean a lot to you.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
............
It is indeed a novel I've loved for a long time, but――

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I don't think I've ever cried before.
...To think I could be moved this deeply...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
I see... That might be true.
After all, it's a novel I read a very long time ago.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to make such a novel discovery...
I was truly fortunate to have come across this novel."
choice_data_list: I'll give that novel a read too.
I'll give that novel a read too.
Maybe there are lots of books like that.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"Still, to make such a novel discovery...
I was truly fortunate to have come across this novel."
choice_data_list: I'll give that novel a read too.
I'll give that novel a read too.
Maybe there are lots of books like that.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Huh... Trainer, you too...?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
A novel that Still in Love
longs for so deeply...
I can't help but wonder what kind of story it is.
choice_data_list: Because I'm sure it's a novel that will leave a lasting impression.

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"...Y-Yes.
Please... do give it a read."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text:
"I pray that this story...
will remain in your heart."

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Fufu, indeed. If it's novels I read in my childhood, I have plenty...

text_block_list.name: Still in Love
text_block_list.text: Talking about it brings back such fond memories. ...Perhaps I'll read it again sometime.
